U.note: Clean pill nav opening a bento grid of beans, subscription, guides, cafes, saved; polished but sparse and fairly conventional.

V.note: Illustrated, colourful bento tiles that fold to a strip and reflow into a rich grid with working tile selection, though the folded state is not fully hidden and mobile loses labels.

W.note: Compact bento panel with roast chips, grind toggle and quantity stepper that reflects in the button, but visually plain and small.

X.note: Bold dark tin-themed design with a popover bento grid that overlaps the hero and sits somewhat cramped, but is distinctive and works.

Y.note: Colourful bento panel with working roast slider, subscription picker, accordions and toggles that update live page state, and a cohesive warm look.

Z.note: Menu panel opens narrow and left-aligned, overlapping and clipping the hero text, which looks unfinished despite a working cart stepper.
